audit.why: 50% over only 8 games, and the chart is mostly Skill with Akshan edging 4-5 and the very late stage. The prose already frames it as a poke lane that Trundle reclaims on items, matching the mirror at audits/top/trundle__akshan.json. Low sample, so I made no rating changes.
Lvl 2-3 poke, Youmuu's, Trundle's Lvl 6 Subjugate, and his two-item drain-tank window are correctly placed and correctly attributed to each side.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry says Pillar of Ice walls off Heroic Swing, in three separate strings. It does the opposite in open lane: Pillar of Ice creates impassable TERRAIN, and Heroic Swing fires a grappling hook INTO terrain. A pillar dropped between you and Trundle is a free anchor you would not otherwise have. The genuine danger is a pillar placed inside the arc, where collision knocks you off the swing. Separately, the entry claims Chomp heals him on hit; it does not.
audit.why: Riot's text for Pillar of Ice: 'creates an ice pillar at target location, becoming impassable terrain and slowing all nearby enemy units.' Riot's text for Heroic Swing: 'fires a grappling hook into terrain then swings around it... gets knocked off when colliding with champions or terrain.' Riot's text for Chomp: 'dealing damage, briefly slowing and sapping some of their Attack Damage' — no heal. The heal is King's Tribute (P), which triggers on nearby unit deaths, amplified by Frozen Domain (W). The mirror reached the same pillar conclusion from Trundle's side and now states it as 'never wall him off — put it inside his arc'.
audit.corrected: Pillar of Ice is terrain, so a pillar in open lane is a free Heroic Swing anchor; the one to fear is a pillar inside your arc, which collides and drops you mid-flight. Chomp (Q, 3.5s, 300 range) saps AD and slows — it does not heal. King's Tribute heals him off dying minions, and Frozen Domain amplifies that healing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flags no cooldown-sequencing advice at all in this matchup.
audit.why: Chomp is 3.5s flat — it is back before you finish a trade, which is exactly why 'poke and step off' is the instruction. Pillar of Ice is 21s at rank 1 and Subjugate 120s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds call in a matchup whose entire late-game framing is 'he out-sustains you'.
audit.why: Frozen Domain increases healing from all sources while he stands on it, stacking on top of King's Tribute and Subjugate. Anti-heal is the item answer, not more lethality.

edits.after: Set Pillar of Ice inside your swing arc — terrain collision drops you mid-flight, then Frozen Domain sticks

edits.before: Trundle is melee with zero ranged poke, so levels 2-3 are yours — your double-shot passive plus the out-and-back Q chip him while he can only walk at you. The trap is his Q bite: it steals your attack damage AND heals him on hit, so never let him close and auto you back in a trade — poke and step off. Hold Heroic Swing (E) as your exit, not your engage; if you swing in, his Frozen Domain (W) gives him the move/attack speed to stick on you and bite repeatedly.
edits.after: Trundle is melee with zero ranged poke, so levels 2-3 are yours — your double-shot passive plus the out-and-back Q chip him while he can only walk at you. The trap is Chomp (Q): a 300-range bite off a 3.5s cooldown that saps your attack damage, so never let him auto back — poke and step off. It does not heal him; King's Tribute (P) does, off every minion dying near him. Hold Heroic Swing (E) as your exit, and never swing at a pillar he set inside your arc.

edits.before: Your double-shot passive and out-and-back Q out-range his entire melee kit; poke and step off before his Q bite can reach you to steal AD and heal.
edits.after: Your double-shot passive and out-and-back Q out-range his 300-range Chomp; step off before the bite, which saps your AD and is back every 3.5s.

edits.before: This is your window: with your first lethality item your Q-into-E burst can swing on him before his drain-tank items exist and before his Q-steal heals through your damage. But respect Pillar of Ice — if he drops it to wall your swing arc and slow you, he turns a poke lane into a brawl he wins. At 6 his Subjugate steals your armor and MR and heals him off your health, so never commit a long fight into his R; chunk and disengage instead.
edits.after: This is your window: with your first lethality item your Q-into-E burst can swing on him before his drain-tank items exist. Read Pillar of Ice correctly — it is terrain, so one dropped in open lane is a free anchor for your swing, while one set inside your arc collides and drops you mid-flight. At 6 Subjugate takes your health, armour and MR and doubles it over 4 seconds, so never commit a long fight into his R; chunk and disengage.

edits.before: This is where he reclaims the lane. A two-item Trundle is a drain-tank — your lethality tickles his health bar while his Q-steal and Subjugate R turn every extended fight into him healing to full off your shots. Don't try to 1v1 him; your R execute and W roam matter more on the rest of his team. Use W's camouflage and reset to gank side lanes and snipe squishies with Comeuppance, and let your team peel — if the game stretches long, he simply out-sustains you head-to-head.
edits.after: This is where he reclaims the lane. A two-item Trundle is a drain-tank — King's Tribute refills him off every dying minion and Frozen Domain amplifies healing from all sources while he stands on the ice, so Grievous Wounds is the item that keeps the duel honest. Even then, don't take it. Your R execute and W roam matter more on the rest of his team: use camouflage to gank side lanes and snipe squishies with Comeuppance, and let your team peel him.

edits.before: Two items in he out-sustains your lethality completely — his Q-steal and Subjugate heal through your burst, so the late 1v1 is his.
edits.after: Two items in he out-sustains you — King's Tribute and Subjugate refill him while Frozen Domain amplifies both, so the late 1v1 is his.

notes: The page had the Pillar of Ice interaction backwards in three places: it said the pillar walls off Heroic Swing. Pillar of Ice is impassable terrain and Heroic Swing grapples INTO terrain, so an open-lane pillar is a free anchor for Akshan — the mirror at audits/top/trundle__akshan.json now tells Trundle players never to wall with it for exactly this reason, and both sides now say the same thing. The real threat is a pillar inside the arc, where collision knocks him off mid-swing. Also removed the claim that Chomp heals: it saps AD only, and the healing belongs to King's Tribute amplified by Frozen Domain, which is where the Grievous Wounds decision sits. Sample is only 8 games, so I left every rating alone.
